operators.name: relu_forward
semantics: Applies ReLU elementwise: y = max(x, 0) for each element.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device, and stride; output is contiguous.
No in-place modification; returns a new tensor.
Applies ReLU pointwise to all elements of x.
x is a CUDA float tensor of shape [64,3,2048,2048]; output same shape, dtype, device, and stride.
Returns the ReLU output tensor unchanged.
